description: This file defines the DeviceConnectionService interface for managing device connection records, including setting and retrieving the last known gateway for a device within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: DeviceConnectionService
classes.description: Interface for managing device connection information, including setting and retrieving the last gateway used by a device.

methods.name: setLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Sets the last gateway that acted on behalf of a device, with span for tracing and a result handler for asynchronous operation.

methods.name: getLastKnownGatewayForDevice
methods.description: Retrieves the last gateway that acted on behalf of a device, with span for tracing and a result handler for asynchronous response.
